user_signal.goal_or_constraint: GitHub migration must yield real Agent products and a control plane that proactively detects architecture drift instead of waiting for the user to enumerate missing dimensions.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Use thin Skill/router plus executable Runtime, authoritative Workflow, owner-local Harness, progressive References, durable Continuity, and a Universal Signal Plane/Architecture Watch rather than a monolithic prompt or another role-only supervisory Agent.
user_signal.counterexample: After the initial architecture rollout all four BUSINESS owner HEADs advanced, the observation cache became stale, Financial still had a roughly 20KB Skill before slimming, A-share and Video independently introduced local architecture-contract 1.1 vocabulary, and the enabled watch had product notification delivery disabled.

failure_classes: shared Agent architecture vocabulary was too narrow, causing independent owner-local contract forks
remote owner observation freshness can drift while local Universal CI remains green
Skill/router bloat can recreate prompt-centric systems after executable Agent runtimes already exist
watch enabled does not imply user notification delivery enabled
takeover can stale a manifest-bound meta-maintenance receipt unless closure surfaces are rebound consistently

Treat disabled product notification delivery as unproven rather than inferring it from an enabled condition-watch task.
Keep takeover/meta-run/manifest version binding fail-closed instead of weakening the regression.

Shared control-plane vocabulary would fork across repositories and Universal could no longer evaluate owner architecture consistently.

second_order_findings: Forcing owner-local 1.1 manifests back to 1.0 would hide a real underspecification in Universal; the shared need was distilled centrally instead.
Accepting arbitrary 1.1 vocabulary would turn compatibility into schema bypass; only explicit aliases and approved field shapes are normalized.
Hardcoding field-shape exceptions in runtime would recreate policy/runtime drift, so normalization now consults the contract declaration and a missing declaration is a tested FAIL.
A watcher that cannot deliver product notifications still has value as a durable GitHub signal emitter, but that narrower guarantee is stated explicitly.
Universal should detect and route owner drift, not become a cross-repository business writer; unresolved Skill bloat remains owner-scoped signals #2-#4.
The first post-rollout observation set became stale after owners evolved, proving remote freshness is an ongoing control-plane responsibility rather than a one-time rollout receipt.
Takeover caused meta-run/manifest version staleness; the strict binding was preserved and the related surfaces were atomically rebound instead of weakening the test.

open_gates: A-share, Novel and Video Skill-router signals #2-#4 remain open until their owner engineering contexts safely slim and revalidate them.
Architecture Watch user-notification delivery is disabled/unproven; durable GitHub signal emission is the proven transport.
Automatic owner repair and unknown future failure-class completeness are not proven.
Universal operator-dependence still requires independent held-out/live maintenance trajectory grading and a distinct verifier.
A truly fresh product chat with a newly admitted real BUSINESS owner remains unproven.
Owner real actions still require methodology receipt 1.3 exact-action independent verification where applicable.
Financial live prose-quality/Personalized Writing DNA outcome evidence, Novel provider-attested isolation, and Video strict isolated review remain open.
Arbitrary ChatGPT-to-GitHub mutation still lacks universal pre-write WRITE_PATH_ENFORCED semantics.
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: This run proves the covered architecture compatibility, contract-driven normalization, remote re-observation, Financial thin-router and durable signal mechanisms at regression/remote-structural evidence levels. It cannot prove global flawlessness, notification delivery, automatic owner repair, or that every future Agent/model/tool/product failure class has been anticipated.
